articles.desc:
A phenomenon seen during the Second Neo Zeon War (Char's Rebellion). 
Char planned to drop the asteroid Axis onto Earth to make it 
uninhabitable. To prevent this, task force Londo Bell succeeded in 
disintegrating Axis, but due to the strength of the explosion, a 
fragment of Axis headed toward Earth.
Amuro attached the ν Gundam to Axis, which had already entered 
Earth's atmosphere, in an effort to turn it back. As a result, 
Psychoframe light was emitted by the mobile unit, attracting nearby 
forces, who gathered around the plummeting Axis. Overcoming divisions 
between Earth Federation and Neo Zeon, they attached their mobile 
suits to Axis and together pushed it back.
The growing Psychoframe light knocked out the mobile suits apart from 
ν Gundam and pushed the asteroid Axis beyond Earth. The Psychoframe 
light which caused this phenomenon was seen from various locations 
across Earth, leaving an impression in the minds of many.

A dimension that Yamato was thrown to from out of a dimensional rift.
Unlike the New Correct Century dimension and the Universal Century
dimension, the ocean in this dimension is blue.
Recent large-scale battles include the following:
-Before 0003: War breaks out between nations of Earth and PLANT after 
the Bloody Valentine Incident.
　　　　　　　　　At the same time, the Earth Alliance and the Jovian 
　　　　　　　　　Federation declare war on each other (the Lizard 
　　　　　　　　　War).
　　　　　　　　　Meanwhile, the Meganoid rebellion kicks off behind 
　　　　　　　　　the scenes.
　　　　　　　　　Celestial Being steps in to intervene on all fronts.
　　　　　　　　　The leader of the Earth Alliance, Alejandro Corner,
　　　　　　　　　and the leader of PLANT, Patrick Zala, are both 
　　　　　　　　　killed, and after the Hot Blooded Coup d'État within 
　　　　　　　　　the Jovian Federation, all conflicts come to an end 
　　　　　　　　　with all sides suffering casualties.
　　　　　　　　　After the wars, the Earth Federation is established.
-Before 0001: The Earth Federation Forces' Autonomous Peace-Keeping
Force A-Laws makes its appearance.
　　　　　　　　　War breaks out between the Earth Federation and
PLANT.
　　　　　　　　　A-Laws is revealed to be just a puppet for Logos and 
the Innovades who outwitted Embryo, and a civil war
　　　　　　　　　breaks out among the Earth Federation. During this
　　　　　　　　　conflict, Gaizok also launches an attack.
　　　　　　　　　The newly restarted Celestial Being, the reformed
　　　　　　　　　Nadesico Squad, the forces of Orb, and others all put 
　　　　　　　　　an end to the battles.

articles.desc:
An area where many of the Zeon Remnants remained after the One Year 
War. Even after the end of that war, the Remnants still engaged in 
intense fighting, biding their time while believing in the 
restoration of the Principality of Zeon.
Desert Rommel, who led a faction of the Zeon Remnants, heard that 
Mineva Zabi had arrived in Dakar and that the AEUG has reappeared, 
and he took a group of his subordinates to protect Mineva, who was 
the successor of the Zabi family.
However, they were not able to withstand the Gundam Team, which had 
state-of-the-art mobile suits.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
An Autonomous Peace-Keeping Force within the Earth Federation Forces. 
They had supra-legal authority beyond that of regular forces, and they
were given priority with deployment of state-of-the-art equipment. 
Under the will of the human-controlling Innovade, Ribbons Almark, 
they suppressed small countries and pockets of resistance that 
opposed the Earth Federation. Later, they also gained the right of 
overall command of regular forces. 
When Celestial Being defeated the Innovades, the Earth Federation 
Forces were reorganized and the A-Laws were disbanded.

A mysterious secret organization that pulls the strings on worldly 
ongoings from behind the scenes. The name Amalgam comes from the
term for a composite or mercury and another metal, and the leaders, 
such as Mr. K (Potassium) and Mr. Fe (Iron), all have metal code names. 
They are seeking out the Whispered and the knowledge they hold about
Black Technology and, as such, come in conflict with Mithril, who seeks
to protect the Whispered.
articles.desc2:
Their goal at the outset was to preserve the future of humanity, saving 
them from all wars, but as the members changed, so did their ideals, and 
eventually they began to care for nothing more than the vested interests 
of their members. 
The organization was democratic in structure, with no real leader,
but was later turned into a more dictatorial structure by Leonard to 
achieve his own personal goals.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
The general term to describe super-technology left by ancient 
Martians. Mystery surrounds the disappearance of the ancient 
Martians, who had such a highly developed civilization, and why the 
remains of their civilization exist around Jupiter.
Examples of the technology include Boson Jump, Distortion Field, 
Gravity Blast, and the phase-transition engine.

A principle advocated by Meitzer Ronah. The basic concept is that 
nobles should be in charge of leading the masses, based upon a belief 
in "noblesse oblige." Cosmo Babylonia was established based on the 
proclamation of this belief.

Arm Slave (short for Armored Mobile Master-Slave System). Humanoid 
weapons that stand at around eight meters tall and weigh in around
ten tons, and were developed as a part of the star wars plans in the 1980s. 
They use special condensed plastic fiber bundles to conduct currents as 
a part of their artificial "Muscle Package" which allow them to imitate their 
pilots' movements with the Semi-Master-Slave system. 
The Savage and Bushnell models are Second Generation units, and the M9
and Shadow models are Third Generation Arm Slaves.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
A newly emerging country in the Middle East with Princess Marina 
Ismail as its leader. 
It collapsed following an attack from the A-Laws, but it is now 
undergoing reconstruction with support of the new government.

The grandchild of the founder of Cosmo Babylonia, Meitzer Ronah. In 
order to hide from her grandfather, previously she went by the alias 
"Cecily Fairchild."
At one time, Berah was welcomed into the Ronah family as the 
figurehead of Cosmo aristocratism, but she rejected this role. She 
spoke scathingly about Cosmo aristocratism and condemned Cosmo 
Babylonia to destruction. At one point, she was almost assassinated 
after she learned of the existence of Jupiter Empire, and in order to 
protect her from further attempts, it was officially reported that 
she had died in an accident.
More than anyone, the thought that a large number of people could 
potentially lose their lives due to the whims of just a few people 
weighed heavily on Berah's mind. This led her to choose to fight for 
the people, sacrificing herself for the good of many and establishing 
the space pirate group, Crossbone Vanguard.
Perhaps influenced by her father, who was a baker, Berah typically 
likes to bake bread to relieve stress. At the end of the Jupiter War, 
she and Kincade Nau decided to go back to using their real names and 
returned to live on Earth.
articles.desc2: Eventually she opened a bakery and had a child with Kincade.

articles.desc:
Immigrants from the planet Beal which was destroyed by Gaizok 200
years ago. The survivors created the interstellar immigration ship
King Beal along with Zambot 3. After departing to find a new home,
they arrived on Earth. The Jin family are descendants of the Bealians
who managed to make it to Earth.

The name of the mascot character of the amusement park Fumofumo Land, 
but the term is typically used to refer to the character 
costume-shaped miniature AS that Sousuke modified and uses. The scar 
on its left cheek, similar to Sousuke's, differentiates it from the 
real Bonta-kun. 
Sousuke goes on to put this unit into mass production for use by
military and police forces. It was a revolutionary high-tech piece of
equipment, but unfortunately never saw a high number of sales.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
The original Lockon Stratos and the elder twin brother of the current 
Lockon. He was the pilot of Gundam Dynames, and his full name was 
Neil Dylandy. He lived until the age of 24. 
As the eldest, he took good care of others, which led to his downfall.
He acted as coordinator for Setsuna and the Gundam Meister, who lacked
cooperative skills. 
This way of life had various repercussions for Setsuna, Tieria, and 
other Celestial Being members.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
An instantaneous means of travel that utilizes ancient Martian 
super-technology. Although it was originally a method of travelling 
through time and space, time travel can still not be controlled.
To perform a jump, a Class-A Jumper is required, or Chulips must be 
present at both entry and exit points. Matter that jumps is 
transformed within the Boson Jump field into boson particles, matter 
with the property of being able to reverse time. Boson particles pass 
backwards through time and arrive at ancient Martian ruins. There, 
the matter is reconverted to boson particles and departs for the 
future. After reappearing randomly in ordinary space, it resumes its 
original state. 
The Calculation Unit that was located in Martian Polar Cap Ruins 
controls all Boson Jumps. Even if the Calculation Unit is not 
available, a jump is possible as long as it exists somewhere.

Former commander of Neo Zeon. His full name is Char Aznable.
His real name was Casval Rem Deikun, and he was the posthumous child 
of Zeon Zum Deikun, who was assassinated by the Zabi family. Known as 
the Red Comet during the One Year War, he was famous for his 
strategic prowess and superior mobile suit operation. In the Gryps 
Conflict, he used the alias "Quattro Bajeena" and fought to overcome 
the Titans, but in the struggle over the Colony Laser, he vanished 
following a one-on-one battle with Haman.
However, three years after the First Neo Zeon War, he reappeared near 
Earth as leader of the revived Neo Zeon. The Spacenoids, who were 
suffering under the oppressive Earth Federation, welcomed him 
enthusiastically and many colonies cooperated with Neo Zeon.
As commander of Neo Zeon, he engaged in political negotiations and 
plots in his struggle against Earth Federation. However, he still had 
feelings for Lalah Sune and therefore hoped to bring his 14 year 
rivalry with Amuro to a conclusion.
He decided upon military action to cause a nuclear winter that would 
remove humanity from Earth. The final showdown with Amuro took
place on Axis, which was at that moment free-falling to Earth. However,
at some point, they were both bathed in Psychoframe light; no one
knows their current whereabouts.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
Refers to enormous ruins left by ancient Martians. Used as entry and 
exit points for Boson Jumping, Chulips make it possible for someone 
without jumping ability to perform a Boson Jump (however, living 
organisms must protect themselves by using a Distortion Field). 
The name Chulip is an acronym of the phrase, "Cellular Hangover from 
Unknown Labyrinthine Intelligence of Prehistorical age."

The name given to humans born after undergoing genetic manipulation 
at the embryonic stage to enhance their intelligence and physical 
strength. Their existence became known in CE 15 after a worldwide 
broadcast where George Glenn revealed that he was the first 
Coordinator.
They are born in possession of many superior physical and mental 
qualities. However, whether or not those abilities reach fruition 
varies according to the environment in which they are raised. Many 
Coordinators live in the PLANTs, but occasionally Coordinators and 
Naturals (humans who have not undergone genetic modification) live 
together openly in neutral nations and lunar cities.
Those born to Natural parents following genetic manipulation are 
described as first-generation Coordinators; in turn, their children 
will be second-generation Coordinators. The birth-rate among 
Coordinators is declining, presenting the Coordinator population with 
a serious problem.

A series of wars that took place between Cosmo Babylonia and the 
Earth Federation. Meitzer Ronah, the founder of Cosmo Babylonia, was 
a supporter of aristocratism and believed that "the nobles should be 
the ones to lead the masses." In an effort to realize this belief, he 
established a private army, referred to as the Crossbone Vanguard, 
and used it to take control of Side 4, proclaiming the founding of 
Cosmo Babylonia.
The Earth Federation dispatched forces to suppress this revolt; 
however, they were overwhelmed due to their lack of fighting 
experience stemming from a long period of peace. However, Berah 
Ronah, the granddaughter of Meitzer Ronah and figurehead of the 
organization, spoke to the people to denounce aristocratism, which 
caused support for Cosmo Babylonia to lose its momentum, and the wars 
drew to a close.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
A major munitions manufacturing group. They are at the core of the 
anti-Nergal firms and are the instigators of the Hisago Plan, having 
been closely involved in the plan from the planning stages.
articles.desc2:
Their true aim is to have a political and economic monopoly, and they 
have been in contact with Kusakabe since the Lizard War.

articles.desc:
An incident that befell Odaiba at the hands of the terrorist group
A-21. 
Enormous Lambda Driver-equipped Behemoth AS units were wreaking 
havoc, but Sousuke showed up in the Arbalest and defeated them, 
crushing A-21. During this battle, Tessa declared her and Kaname to be
at war over Sousuke's heart.

The Battle in which Neo Zeon and Londo Bell launched an attack on the
Earth Federation assembly being held in Dakar, just days after
Hathaway and Banagher had met the Neo Zeon solider Loni Garvey.
Banshee's G-Hound intervened, splitting the battle three ways, but with 
Sousuke and his newly obtained ARX-8 Laevatein, Londo Bell won the
battle in the end. 
Meanwhile, while watching the battle play out on scene with Kaname,
Leonard reveals to her that she is the cause of the whole Newtype
tragedy.
articles.desc2:
The Battle in which Neo Zeon and Londo Bell launched an attack on the
Earth Federation assembly being held in Dakar, just days after
Hathaway and Banagher had met the Neo Zeon solider Loni Garvey.
Banshee's G-Hound intervened, splitting the battle three ways, but with 
Sousuke and his newly obtained ARX-8 Laevatein, Londo Bell won the 
battle in the end. 
Meanwhile, while watching the battle play out on scene with Kaname,
Leonard reveals to her that she is the cause of the whole Newtype
tragedy because of the Psycommu technology that Kaname Sagara, her
double from a parallel world, possesses.

articles.desc:
The leader of the Meganoids. Bestows praise by exclaiming,
"Aora! Don Zauser!"
His exposed brain and metallic body set him appart in appearance from any
of the other Meganoids.
He aims to turn humans into Meganoids, then to forge an everlasting
prosperity by conquering the universe. However, he is in a state of
unconsciousness, and so must command the Meganoids through Koros,
who shares his vision.
Koros' defeat caused him to awaken full of rage. He transformed into a
giant and chased after the Daitarn 3, but was ultimately defeated by
Banjo's wrath.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
Gargantuan aggressive creatures that came from Singular, a gateway to
another dimension. Numerous types have been discovered, with the
smaller ones ranging from 15-20m and the larger ones spanning over
100m from head to tail. 
Arzenal was founded to fight off these Dragons, and all Norma are
fated to a life of battle against them.
articles.desc2:
It is later revealed that these creatures are humans from Earth who 
have altered their genes in order to survive the conditions on their 
world. The men became huge Dragons that are able to absorb Dracunium 
crystals, purifying them within their bodies, and the women became 
smaller Dragons that give birth to and raise children while working 
to recreate their world. Female Dragons look like human women, but 
they have wings and a tail, and they are able to fly.
The original Dragon, Aura, was captured and held prisoner by Embryo,
and the Dragons put their everything into freeing her, eventually
leading Salamandinay to join forces with Ange and the Norma, fighting
side by side in battle.

articles.desc:
Former PLANT Supreme Council Chairman. Unlike the previous Chairman, 
Patrick Zala, Durandal belonged to a moderate faction which sought 
peaceful coexistence with Naturals. At the time of the Junius Seven 
incident and during the later battle with the Earth Alliance, he 
displayed outstanding leadership, always making level-headed 
decisions.
Meer Campbell was suggested as a double for Lacus Clyne to bolster 
the fighting spirit of the PLANTs as a whole, but the secret plan to 
assassinate Lacus was leaked to the public, causing distrust among 
Kira and his associates.
Durandal's ultimate aim was to realize his "Destiny Plan," in which 
he would construct a regulated society where people were controlled 
at a genetic level. After defeating Logos, he introduced his plan to 
the world, pushing for its implementation. However, Kira and his 
colleagues opposed the idea of a world in which there would be no 
evolution and successfully prevented the plan from being carried out.
Eventually, Durandal was shot by Rey Za Burrel, who he had thought of 
as his own son. He took his last breaths in the arms of his former 
lover, Talia Gladys, who, although they had separated, still had 
feelings for him.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
A sport from the world of Cross Ange in which two teams face off
to try and score points by getting the ball in the other's goal. The 
players play in pairs, with two people riding each of the 
motorcycle-like machines that fly using Mana. One player pilots while 
the other uses a stick to carry the ball. 
Princess Angelise paired with Momoka and was one of the sport's star
athletes.

A special task force established by the Earth Federation Forces. Its 
main duties are subversive activities, infiltration, and 
neutralization.
Members are selected based on their ability to perform missions 
regardless of the nature of the operation or the location. They must 
also have no scruples about the means required to perform their 
duties.
Depending on the nature of the mission they have been entrusted with, 
they might need to use force or operate solo. This has led other 
Federation task forces to view them as shady and untrustworthy.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
As living metal beings who came from deep space, ELS is an 
abbreviation of "Extraterrestrial Living-metal Shape-shifters." 
They have the ability to attach themselves to humans operating 
machinery, turning them into metal and assimilating the people and 
weapons they invade. They are also attracted to quantum brainwaves. 
The ELS are a colony of organisms and do not possess an individual 
identity.
articles.desc2:
Through conversation with Setsuna, they came to understand that 
Earthlings existed based upon an "ego," then reconfigured into the 
shape of a flower and ended hostilities. Thereafter, the ELS co-existed
with humans and were a powerful force in human advancement 
into deep space.

articles.desc:
A system developed by the Lunar Special Tactical Lab. It was sent to
the Earth's 3rd Special Tactical Lab where it was planned to be put
into operation. 
The whole system is small enough to fit in a carry-case, and while
the details surrounding it are a bit of a mystery, it is said to be
the very thing that could save the Earth.
articles.desc2:
Its name stands for Earth Regeneration System 100, and just as its 
name suggests, it is the core of a system meant to control a series 
of processes meant to reconstruct civilization from a devastated 
Earth. It was believed to have been developed by the Lunar Special 
Tactical Lab, but was actually based on strange artifacts found at 
the bottom of the dried-up sea, and it turns out to be a device from 
the Super Civilization Gardim's Civilization Reconstruction System, 
Nevanlinna. 
ERS-100 was sent to Earth's 3rd Special Tactical Lab and was planned 
to undergo further research, but was instead sent with Yamato 
to Earth as the control OS for the VangRay. Feeling like an 
incomplete version of itself, it began referring to itself as System 
Nine-Nine, and then by the name Nine when it acquired an android 
body.

articles.desc:
A resistance movement formed to fight the Titans' privatized Earth 
Federation Forces. Their full name is the Anti-Earth Union Group. 
Through collaboration with companies such as Anaheim Electronics and 
Luio Company, and under the leadership of Brigadier General Blex 
Forer, who had strong ties with political and business circles, the 
group is able to command a certain amount of power, both in military 
and political circles.
Because they were a division of the Earth Federation Forces, like the 
Titans, the majority of soldiers are Federation military. When they 
battled the Titans, therefore, it was as if the Earth Federation 
Forces had turned on itself.
At the time of the theft of the test MS Gundam Mk-II on Gryps, the 
previously minor skirmishes with the Titans escalated into full-scale 
conflict.

Observational equipment for the Lambda Driver developed by Mira
Kudan. When equipped on an AS, the outside monitor acquires a
green filter and utilizes different shades to display the effective
range, strengths, and weaknesses of other Lambda Driver-equipped
units. This allows the unit to fully comprehend an enemy's Lambda
Driver abilities, reading their movements and allowing them to attack
from effective distances and locations, and finally making it
possible to take them down even using M9 units.

A human who underwent artificial enhancements at Murasame Research 
Lab. Her full name was Four Murasame, and she was a Psycho Gundam 
pilot with the nominal rank of ensign.
Four had a cheerful and lively personality normally, but when she was 
in the Psycho Gundam, she was badly affected by the psycho-control 
waves and experienced both intense headaches and fits of insanity.
Something caused her to lose her past memories, a fact which pains 
her deeply, causing her to fall into insolent rages at times. Four is 
not her real name: she was called that simply because she was the 
fourth experiment at the Murasame Research Lab. Four believed that if 
she defeated Gundam Mk-II, she would recover her memories, and this 
belief spurred her to endure the headaches as she fought in the 
Psycho Gundam.
After meeting Kamille Bidan, she had her first experience of human 
warmth and friendship. However, she was greatly disturbed upon later 
learning that he was a Gundam Mk-II pilot. Despite this, she was 
eventually able to free herself from her mental curse, and she 
sacrificed herself to protect Kamille, dying in the crossfire of 
battle.

Fighting between the Neo Zeon group, led by Haman Karn, and the 
Federation Forces.
Taking advantage of the weakness of the Federation, which had lost 
its military strength in the Gryps Conflict, Axis, part of the Zeon 
Remnants, took on the name "Neo Zeon" and sent a detachment to 
suppress the colonies. In the beginning of the war, Neo Zeon had the 
advantage. However, Glemy Toto, a Neo Zeon officer, suddenly declared 
himself the true successor of Zeon, and, in a surprise move, carried 
out an attack to take control of Axis, turning everything on its head.
A struggle arose between Glemy and Haman, which led to Neo Zeon 
losing its Axis base and caused many to suddenly defect to the 
Federation. Later, the leaders of both forces, Glemy and Haman, 
banded together to attack the Gundam team of Nahel Argama. Neo Zeon 
then collapsed as an organization, and the First Neo Zeon War drew to 
a close.

An alien who plans to annihilate all Earthlings. After he destroyed 
Planet Beal 200 years ago, he fell into a long slumber then reawoke 
when he approached Earth's atmosphere. In order to eradicate the 
Earthlings, whom he deemed to be evil creatures, he ordered Butcher to
begin attacking Earth. His true identity is actually a computer 
created by the Gaizokians that responds to creatures with evil 
thoughts. Even after Kappei defeated him, he kept asking whether 
Earthlings were really worth protecting right up to the end.

A nation that is at war with the Great Gamillan Empire. They are
currently fighting in the Small Magellanic Cloud.

Dr. Saotome's daughter. When her father was killed in front of her 
eyes, she closed up her heart. After the world was polluted by the 
Getter Rays, Benkei gave her a new name, "Kei," to protect her from 
the people who hated Dr. Saotome, and raised her as his own daughter.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
An exciting anime about robots created in the late 21st century. Its 
official title was "Gekiganger 3" (however, from the 27th episode, 
the name changed to "Hot-Blooded Robots—Gekiganger 3.") 
The show revolved around giant robots that were able to combine into 
three different forms, and who fought against the Kyo'akk Empire that 
planned to invade the Earth. The story spanned a total of 39 
episodes. It was one of the few items of visual media that people 
were able to bring with them when escaping from the moon to Jupiter, 
and it has now become somewhat of a national treasure in the Jovian 
Federation. 
Reruns can still be seen on Earth as well, and the series enjoys a 
cult following with some anime fans.

His full name is Gengoro Jin. Once the Fishermen's Boss at Jin 
Fishery in Suruga Bay, after Beal I was discovered, he became its 
captain and assumed the role of battle commander. Although he's a 
strict man, he loves his wife and children very much and is a true 
man of the sea who's brimming with manliness and magnanimity. Since 
he had to leave home a lot for deep-sea fishing, he truly values any 
chance he gets to spend time with his family. He sacrificed himself 
to take out Red Knight Deathcain and Blue Knight Helldyne in order to 
protect his wife.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
Mobile suits equipped with an artificial solar furnace. Pronounced 
"Jinx." 
A total of 30 were provided to the three world powers by defectors 
from Celestial Being before the establishment of Earth Federation. 
The mobile units were built to be practical and eliminated 
customization as much as possible. Consequently, while they were 
inferior, under certain conditions, such as in limited combat, they 
were an even match for the Gundams of Celestial Being. The cockpits 
were simple, and anybody with some experience piloting a mobile suit 
could operate one. This was because they were designed so that pilots 
of the Union, AEU, and HRL could operate them.
GN-X were supplied to United Nation Forces, who drove Celestial Being 
to its destruction. Of the 30 identical GN drives, one fell into the 
hands of Graham Aker, and was placed on his Union Flag Custom. 
Therefore, only 29 actually took part in battle.

The person who instigated a rebellion against Haman Karn at the end 
of the First Neo Zeon War. His full name was Glemy Toto.
He was the master of Elpeo Ple and the Ple Series, and used them to 
form a Newtype squad in an effort to control Neo Zeon. However, he 
was eventually attacked by the Zeta Gundam piloted by Roux Louka and 
died.

A war that began after the theft of Gundam by AEUG in UC 0087. It 
was initially a conflict between AEUG and the Titans, who were 
strengthening their suppression of the Spacenoids, but later Axis, 
who were supporting the restoration of the Principality of Zeon, 
joined to make it a three-way battle.
Because Titans Commander Jamitov Hymen had control over the 
Federation Forces and government, the Titans enjoyed an early 
advantage for a time. But later, after the speech at Dakar, the 
brutality of the Titans was revealed, and AEUG gained the upper hand.
AEUG then seized the Colony Laser, the ultimate weapon of the Titans. 
This was a decisive factor in their victory and in the annihilation 
of the Titans fleet; however, Axis saw that they were at a 
disadvantage and withdrew from the final battle over the Colony 
Laser, conserving their military force. Instead of ending with that 
battle, the conflict developed into the First Neo Zeon War.

A wormhole opening created by the prehistoric civilization, Aquarius.
The Earthlings call it a Subspace Gate. It's controlled by a system
satellite that administers the gate, and passing through it allows
for quick travel across extremely long distances.
articles.desc2:
Currently, Gamillas controls it, and has created a Subspace Gate
Network centered around the planet Balun. By using two gates
located in the Milky Way and the Large Magellanic Cloud, the
Yamato was able to make up for the lost time on their voyage.

articles.desc:
The people of Gatrantis. They are aggressive, and the Gamillans call
them barbaric. They invaded Gamillan territory and continued to
fight with Gamillas in the Small Magellanic Cloud, until Domel's
Small Magellanic Region Army destroyed 70% of their outpost fleet.
articles.desc2:
In previous battles, all prisoners of war taken by Gamillas were
sent to the 17th Detention Center on Planet Leptaporda, where they 
were under the control of the center's head officer. Later, during an 
uprising, the prisoners' anger exploded and they displayed their 
monstrous strength by tossing Gamillan mechanical soldiers into the 
air.

articles.series: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid
articles.desc:
A member of Mithril's intelligence division in Hong Kong. Looking
like nothing more than your average businessman, he works as a trader
for cover. During Sousuke's and the others' operations in Hong Kong, 
Gavin provided them with the information and commodities they needed.
articles.desc2:
Even after the destruction of Mithril, Gavin fled from the sights of
Amalgam, and along with Al and Miller, he worked on constructing the
ARX-8 Laevatein, continuing the fight against them.

articles.desc:
Leader of the resource asteroid, Axis, where the remnant of the 
Principality of Zeon forces gathered. Her full name was Haman Karn.
She helped Mineva, the eight-year-old orphan of Dozle Zabi, and led 
the entire Axis forces as director. She had a relentless and 
merciless personality.
Haman supported the restoration of Zeon and raised Axis forces 
comparable to the Titans and AEUG, who had been in hiding on an 
asteroid. She also possessed great political skill, as well as being 
an extremely advanced Newtype who piloted the mobile suit Qubeley, 
displaying overwhelming strength in battle.
After the Gryps Conflict, she took advantage of the weakened Earth 
Federation Forces, raising the flag of Neo Zeon and becoming their 
actual leader. Later, she tried to take Federation Council in Dakar 
through a bloodless coup, but due to the internal struggles with 
Glemy's faction, her aspiration was not realized. Finally, she lost 
to Judau's ZZ Gundam in one-on-one battle, and was fatally wounded.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
The main computer in the Nadesico series. Its official name was 
"SVC2027." It was installed in Nadesico A, even during the Lizard 
War. When Nadesico A was sent far away together with the Calculation 
Unit, Omoikane was removed and later installed in Nadesico B.
Although it was a computer, it possessed an ego and developed a 
strong bond of friendship with Ruri Hoshino.
articles.desc2:
Later it was transferred to Nadesico C, and with Hari Makibi and
the rest to greet Rui. After making a Boson Jump over the Martian Polar
Cap Ruins under the navigation of Inez Fressange, Omoikane managed
to gain control of all enemy systems in the Martian sector with Ruri.

articles.desc:
100 years ago, the New Correct Century year 2100, was the peak
in the battle between the Earthnoids and Spacenoids, which had
started with the One Year War. 
Legend has it that it all came to an end with Char's Rebellion, but
what followed was the Lost Decade, in which most records over nearly
ten years were lost. Many believe that during these ten years
anti-federation organizations continued to launch terrorist attacks
until the climactic and tragic Mufti Incident brought the wars to an
end. But with the onslaught of the Gamillan attacks on Earth, there
are few who have time to worry over matters of history, and most
widely distributed information is often far from the truth.
articles.desc2:
Research later goes on to show that this "Lost Decade" was actually
a planned falsity by the Earth Federation Government, which feared
the influence of the Charter of the Universal Century.

articles.series: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid
articles.desc:
The battle in which the ARX-7 Arbalest single-handedly took down five
PLAN-1059 Chodar C units. 
Before the battle, Sousuke had seemingly given up all hope for various 
reasons. He thought Kaname had died right in front of his eyes, but when 
she shows up again, he gets ahold of himself, and with her to motivate 
him, he returns to his normal soldier self. After Kaname points out a 
number of his shortcomings, Sousuke finally accepts his AI partner Al, and 
the two work in unison. As a result, the Lambda Driver's powers were 
finally unlocked to their maximum potential, allowing them to take down 
the five Chodar units and Gates.

Banjo Haran's father. He has earned Banjo's undying hatred for 
creating the Meganoids and sacrificing his own wife and son to his 
research. No one knows what has happened to Sozo since then.

The edge of the boundary to the Solar System, which is created from
the sun's winds knocking interstellar matter into magnetic fields.
Since traversing the Heliopause prevents ships from communicating with
the Earth, those who requested it were allowed to speak with their
families one last time.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
This was a plan to build a network within the Solar System to ensure 
stable Boson Jumping. The network would comprise of 30 large Terminal 
Colonies and countless small colonies, forming a complete route 
between Earth and Mars. The bases were Chulips left by the ancient 
Martians, and a Chulip was used as the core of each Terminal Colony. 
The basic concept involved someone entering a Chulip, making a Boson 
Jump, then emerging from another Chulip; however, it is not possible 
to move freely between Chulip. Instead, it is only possible to jump 
between connected entrances and exits. 
However, it will first be necessary to investigate the relationships 
between Chulips before they can be placed strategically throughout 
the Solar System.

Keiko's grandfather. His full name is Heizaemon Kamikita. He's 
essentially the elder of the Jin family and has unified his clan in 
the battle against Gaizok through his powerful will and beliefs.
He's cousins with Ume, who proves to be a reliable advisor, and is 
thought to have gotten along quite well with her due to the fact that 
he sent her a teacup when he was young. In his final moments, he 
launched an assault on Bandock with Beal II in order to save King 
Beal and left the rest to the younger generation.
He's the narrator in the anime's next episode previews and always 
ended them with, "Now, how are they going to fight themselves out of 
this one?" After he launched his special assault, he even narrated 
his own actions in third person with, "Well, how is he going to 
handle this fight?"

Kappei's older brother. His full name is Ichitaro Jin. Contrary to 
his younger brother, he's serious and mild-mannered and acted as 
battle commander for King Beal and Beal I. He has very sharp 
observation skills and discovered Zambot 3's combination system. When 
this happened, he stopped the Zambo Ace in order to warn Kappei's 
group since they weren't coming to an agreement and said, "If we 
can't fight with Kappei, who has no sense of solidarity, then there's 
no point in the Jin family going on living. Let's die together." This 
daring, yet clever threat succeeded in forcing them to combine.
Ichitaro managed to survive the battle with Gaizok and used Beal I to 
slow down the Bandock when he was charging into the atmosphere. 
Then, in order to save Kappei, who was still inside, he sacrificed himself
and disappeared in the explosion.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
The forefront of AEU mobile suits at the time when Celestial Being first
began its armed intervention. 
It was a solar energy model whose key feature was to be able to accept
a supply of power from the orbital elevator's generation system. It
theoretically had an unlimited operational time, excluding external
factors such as ammunition and propellant. It was developed based on
Union Flag and therefore had many similarities in features such as
structural transformation and weaponry. 
AEU's ace pilot Patrick Colasour operated the finished unit for its 
launch and demonstration; and though he gave a high spirited 
performance, Enact was heavily damaged by the Gundam Exia piloted
by Setsuna.

A colony owned by Anaheim Electronics. The colony even includes a 
shopping area and the Anaheim Industry Technical School, but various 
parts are still under construction, so construction machinery are 
constantly working away.
Megalanica, a colony builder, is stationed there, as well as the head 
of the Vist Foundation, Cardeas Vist, who has his home there.
articles.desc2:
In a battle between the Earth Federation Forces and Sleeves, 
Industrial 7 suffered major damage, but Megalanica was unaffected, 
and Laplace's Box was concealed there.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
The woman in charge of medicine and science on Nadesico A. Her full 
name was Inez Fressange. She came from Mars, and was rescued by 
Nadesico A as a Martian refugee. 
Inez was a rare example of someone with the ability of a Class-A 
Jumper. She enjoyed explaining things to others, and she also created 
the "Nadesico What! & Why?" programs that were broadcast on board 
Nadesico A. After the end of the Lizard War, she stayed at Nergal 
Heavy Industries to continue her research; however, one day it was 
announced that she had died in an plane accident.
articles.desc2:
In reality, Akatsuki spread this false rumor after he became aware 
that the Martian Successors were abducting Class-A Jumpers.

articles.desc:
Bacterial life forms that wander the galaxy. Getter Rays act as their 
main source of energy. After some started leeching off the Getter 
Rays that had been harvested on the moon, they were compressed at a 
high density in the Getter Core and evolved into three huge Parent 
Invaders.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
Information terminals designed to serve in Aeolia Schenberg's plan. 
They have the same appearance as humans. 
With the help of GN particles, they have responsive capabilities in 
the use of quantum brainwaves and a link to the quantum supercomputer 
Veda. They also use gene manipulation and nano-machines to control
aging.
Ribbons Almark and the other Innovades awaited the day when 
Innovators would be the humans of the new age. Ribbons called himself 
an Innovator and tried to control humanity.

Kalinin's deceased wife who passed away more than ten years ago. 
While Kalinin was in the middle of combat operations in Afghanistan, 
she was killed in a medical accident at the hands of her doctor, 
dying along with the child she was carrying.

The alias of Carozzo Ronah, commander of the Crossbone Vanguard at 
the outbreak of the Cosmo Babylonia Wars. He was the biological 
father of Cecily Fairchild (Berah Ronah).
Hiding his weaknesses behind a metal mask, he enhanced his body in 
order to help realize Meitzer Ronah's ideals of aristocratism. As a 
result, his body could travel in space, he could open the hatch of a 
mobile suit with his bare hands, and he could control mobile armor 
using brainwaves.
In order to purge humans opposed to aristocratism, he secretly 
advanced the Rafflesia Project, creating anti-human responsive 
exterminators, known as Bugs, and the mobile armor Rafflesia. After 
dispatching Bugs to Frontier I, which massacred the entire population 
there, he piloted the Rafflesia and personally fought against Cecily 
and Seabook (Kincade Nau). A fierce battle ensued, and even though he 
managed to deal significant damage to the F91 piloted by Seabook, he 
was destroyed in the confusion caused by physically manifested
afterimages.

Refers to an event where enemies Athrun Zala and Cagalli Yula Athha 
met on a deserted island.
With their units broken, neither was able to leave the island and 
they met on the shore. After a physical fight, Athrun took Cagalli 
captive, but he did not kill his prisoner, and they decided to spend 
the night in a cave, awaiting rescue.
Cagalli, however, had other plans and seized the first chance she got 
to steal Athrun's gun, immediately shattering any fragile truces that 
there had been previously. After they discussed their lives and 
feelings, though, Cagalli found herself unable to shoot Athrun. 
Seeing this, Athrun put his knife away and the two waited for morning 
to come. The next day, when it became apparent that they would both 
be rescued, they exchanged names for the first time before returning 
to their respective forces.

A war that broke out in UC 0133 between Jupiter Empire, Earth 
Federation, and the space pirates, Crossbone Vanguard.
At the beginning of the war, when the Federation was unaware of the 
Jupiter Empire's actions, only Crossbone Vanguard realized what was 
truly happening and began to quietly make moves against them.
However, after Dogatie declared a worldwide nuclear attack, the 
Colony forces, who were taking a cautious approach with regard to the 
Earth Federation Forces, decided to join the fight, a move which led 
to all-out war against Jupiter Empire.
In the final stages of the war, the true Dogatie descended to Earth 
in the giant mobile armor Divinidad to pollute the planet with 
nuclear weapons. However, Tobia and Kincade pursued him, and put a 
stop to his plans. The war ended with the death of Supreme Leader 
Dogatie.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
A nation of people who had been originally living on the moon. They 
fled to Jupiter fearing for their safety due to the increasingly 
negative opinion of themselves held by those on Earth. Its official 
name was "The Anti-Earth Jupiter Sphere Alliance of Ganymede, 
Callisto, Europa, and Other Planetoid Nations." 
They were able to survive in the harsh Martian conditions by adopting 
the super-technology left behind by the ancient Martians. The Jovian 
Federation also made use of this Martian technology to battle their 
enemy, and war erupted between the two planets. Eventually, however, 
a peace treaty was signed and now they are also part of the Earth 
Alliance.

The name Sousuke went by as a child, given to him by the legendary
leader of the Helmajistan guerrillas when the then eight-year-old Sousuke
Sagara tried to assassinate him. Sousuke and Gauron first met during
these times, and Gauron still calls him Kashim to this day, something
he absolutely detests.

Sousuke was tasked with looking after her before he was assigned to
Kaname. She is also one of the Whispered and was subjected to
numerous experiments before she was put under protection.
articles.desc2:
Mithril brought her in for rehabilitation and let her harness her 
true abilities. She then went on and contributed in large part to the 
construction of the ARX-8 Laevatein that Al designed, finally 
repaying Sousuke for saving her.

articles.desc:
The second leader of the Vist Foundation. 60 years old. He was 
Banagher and Alberto's father, and the brother of Martha Vist Carbine.
Determined to fulfill the wishes of the first leader, Syam Vist, 
Cardeas resolved to reveal the existence of Laplace's Box, so he used 
his position as orchestrator of the UC Project to upload the Laplace 
Program to the Unicorn Gundam.
He was a person who could do what was necessary with a strong 
conviction that his own actions were the right ones. However, because 
he acted according to his own standards, he sometimes lacked 
consideration for others. During the Industrial 7 War, he was shot by 
Alberto and suffered a fatal injury. Afterwards, he entrusted the 
Unicorn Gundam to Banagher and vanished in an explosion.

articles.series: True Mazinger Edition Z: The Impact!
articles.desc:
Machine creatures that were left behind by the Ancient Mycenaean 
Empire. They possess battle-oriented minds and were programmed to 
destroy all other civilizations.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
Now deceased, she was the operator of Ptolemaios in battle. Her full 
name was Christina Sierra. 
She was skilled in operating computers, high level programming, and 
hacking. She joined Celestial Being for the opportunity to use her 
skills, rather than because she supported their principles of 
conduct. 
She had a vibrant personality. However, her psychological weakness 
was that she lacked resolution in battle, thus she could be backed 
into a corner and panic. 
Under all-out attack by the United Nation Forces, she perished in an 
explosion together with the helmsman of Ptolemaios, Lichty.

Refers to the attack on the Titans' base at Kilimanjaro. Unforeseen 
circumstances led Kamille and Quattro to descend to Earth and join 
the battle. In the enemy's base, Kamille again met Four Murasame, the 
Artificial Newtype whom he had met previously in Hong Kong. Kamille 
had tried to reconnect with Four, but as a result of further mental 
experimentation, she considered him an enemy.
During the battle, Four recovered her wits due to prompting from 
Kamille and after being hit badly. She then stopped attacking 
Kamille, but the moment they reconciled, Jerid Messa appeared to 
attack them in the Byarlant. Four protected Kamille, and was herself 
killed.
As a result, Four's Psycho Gundam, which was invaluable to the enemy 
forces, was disabled, and owing to the action of the Karaba led by 
Amuro Ray, the Kilimanjaro base was destroyed.

A terrorist bombing that took place at the residence of the Earth 
Federation prime minister in the year UC 0001.
During a ceremony marking the end of the AD calendar and the start of 
the Universal Century, as well as the beginning of the space 
colonizing business, Laplace suddenly exploded. The first prime 
minister, Ricardo Marcenas, died, together with several 
leaders and other important people from various countries, resulting 
in a disastrous beginning to the Universal Century. As a result, 
there was a crack-down on anti-Earth Federation sentiment, and this 
later impacted the birth of Zeon.
articles.desc2:
One of the terrorists involved in the plot was the young Syam Vist. 
He saw the stone tablet of the UC Charter in the wreckage from the 
explosion and decided to take it.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
A war that occurred between the Earth Alliance and the Jovian 
Federation (official name, "The Anti-Earth Jupiter Sphere Alliance of 
Ganymede, Callisto, Europa, and Other Planetoid Nations"). The first 
conflict occurred in AD 2195 and is known as the First Battle of Mars. 
Although commonly referred to as the Lizard War, it was not 
technically a war, but rather a series of conflicts.

A series of plots designed to rebel against the Earth Federation, 
led by Hathaway Noa, alias "Mufti Nabiyu Erin."
Although his purge of corrupt Federation Congress officials amounted 
to terror, the plots were supported by the public, who disliked the 
oppressive government.
Eventually Hathaway, as leader of the organization, was executed by 
the government, and the anti-Federation movement died with him.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
The term used to describe the pilots of Para-Mail, often simply 
shorted to "rider." All riders are based out of Arzenal and they
themselves are considered weapons that wield Para-Mail. 
They typically are granted no personal freedoms, but they are 
afforded a semblance of financial freedom in that they are allowed to 
use the money they earn from defeating Dragons to customize their 
units or to buy their way out of penalties.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
Highly advanced informational technology that allows everything to be
controlled solely by thought. It allows willpower alone to interfere
with physical phenomenon, emit energy, control movement, and allow
access to shared data via an integrated system. 
Its use has resulted in a deeper ability for people to sympathize
with one another, eliminating poverty and inequality, creating a
peaceful utopian world.
articles.desc2:
In reality, however, what at first appears to be the most perfect 
world ever created, in fact draws its power from the Dracunium energy 
emitted by the imprisoned Aura, and the lack of poverty and 
inequality is really just an illusion crafted by Embryo, the creator 
of Mana.
Devastated by how foolish humanity remained even after he granted 
Them the power of Mana, Embryo began working to fuse space-time to
create a brand new world. When he began this space-time fusion, the
whole world was suddenly deprived of their access to Mana and thrown
into chaos.

articles.desc:
An army of cyborgs that rebelled and fought against humans. 
Banjo's father, Sozo Haran, originally created Meganoids to help 
expand further into space, but they eventually developed their own 
inflated sense of self-worth, and under the lead of Don Zauser and 
Koros they attempted to turn all humans into Meganoids. 
The Meganoid commanders use Macro Machines to transform into 
Megaborgs that tower over 100m tall.

The name of the plan that was used during the Battle in the Vicinity 
of Pluto, where UN Cosmo Navy First Fleet tried to take over the 
Gamillas Pluto Frontline Base. It was actually a decoy meant to 
divert the enemy's attention, and their true goal was to safely meet 
their Iscandarian visitor on Mars.
Although Sasha, the visitor from Iscandar, died in an accident, Kodai
and Shima, who had been waiting on Mars, managed to recover the wave
motion core she brought, allowing the M Operation to end successfully.
But it cost them a great sacrifice, and since their true goal was kept
top secret, many of the people who were involved in the mission,
including Kodai's older brother Mamoru, died without ever knowing
the truth.

An anti-Earth Federation organization. Also the name of its leader.
The name "Mufti Nabiyu Erin," a neologism derived from numerous 
languages, means "Righteous King of Prophets."
articles.desc2:
Hathaway Noa, son of Bright Noa, joined the organization and, as its 
leader, adopted the alias Mufti Nabiyu Erin.

articles.desc:
A mercenary, anti-terrorism organization founded to preserve 
peace around the globe. Their name comes from the fantasy term for
silver, Mithril. 
Their work consists not only of overthrowing and eradicating military
dictatorships, but also protecting the Whispered. As such, they are
equipped with weapons and armaments ten years more advanced than
most militaries and often get new equipment before it ever sees official
military adoption. 
Mithril is made up of a Tactical Operations Division, Intelligence
Division, and Research Division, with the West Pacific Fleet's Tuatha
De Daanan belonging to Tactical Operations.

articles.series: True Mazinger Edition Z: The Impact!
articles.desc:
The one who bears the duty of resurrecting the Mycenaean Gods. This 
refers to Tristan and Isolde, the couple whose halves were merged to 
create Baron Ashura. By giving up their lives, they succeeded in 
resurrecting the Mycenaean Gods, but Ashura was hypnotized by Dr. 
Hell to prevent suicide.

Leonard's mother betrayed her husband by having relationships with
other men.
When a burglar broke into Leonard’s home, his mother used him to protect 
herself. This incident deeply affected his personality.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
A public holiday on Arzenal, and the only day of the year that humans 
have granted Norma as time off. All training is cancelled on this 
day, and everyone relaxes by participating in a grand sports 
festival to win huge prizes, or by heading out to the gambling 
parlors and amusement parks. Traditionally, all participants in the 
sports festival wear bathing suits. 
Salia describes it the one day of the year that makes having to deal 
with all the terrible things worth it.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
An action film made after the downfall of A-Laws. It contained much 
propaganda content, laying blame for the scandals of the Earth 
Federation upon A-Laws and those who were behind them, depicting 
Celestial Being as defeating them. The mastermind behind A-Laws was 
shown as Alejandro Corner, former United Nation ambassador, whose 
actions were controlled by the Innovade Ribbons Almark. 
Rather than recounting events realistically, the film emphasized 
heroic aspects, and the Celestial Being members were depicted with 
fictional personalities. For those involved in the events depicted, 
the over-acting and glorification were bittersweet.

Sousuke met her in Namusaku, South East Asia.
In order to raise funds to rebuild her broken-down village and her school, 
she participated in the AS battle arena as team leader and mechanic of 
the weak team "Crossbow." She hired Sousuke to pilot the initial series 
Savage, and they developed a strong bond.
She did not undergo any special training, but has exceptionally profound 
knowledge of AS, which is why Sousuke suspects her of being a Whispered.

Refers to humans who are born naturally, without having undergone 
genetic modification. The term was coined when the first 
Coordinators, genetically modified humans, were created.
Many Naturals harbor jealousy or even hatred towards the 
Coordinators, who possess superior capabilities. Also, many 
Coordinators are boastful about their abilities and look down on 
Naturals. As a result, some Naturals openly express their opposition 
to Coordinators, the most active of these being those who belong to 
the group, Blue Cosmos.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
One of the largest industrial firms in the world. The current 
president is Nagare Akatsuki. At the core of the company is Nergal 
Heavy Industries. 
They were heavily involved in the development of Mars prior to the 
Lizard War, and aimed to monopolize the remaining ancient Martian 
technology to increase their authority. As part of this plan, they 
built and operated Nadesico. However, following the end of the Lizard 
War, due to the promotion of the anti-Nergal Hisago Plan, they are 
now likely to be wiped out.

A secret anti-Angel military organization run by the U.N. with 
branches in each country. Its headquarters are located in Japan's 
Tokyo-3, led by Commander Gendo Ikari and Vice Commander Kozo 
Fuyutsuki. Very little else about the organization is known.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
Humans with a mutation that prevents them from using Mana. Unable to
make use of Mana, the foundation of modern society, the Norma are cast
out as outsiders and treated with much aggression and hatred. 
This mutation only occurs in women, though the reason why is unknown. 
Once it is discovered that someone is a Norma, the Quarantine Officer
casts them out into isolation on Arzenal.
articles.desc2:
Humans with a mutation that prevents them from using Mana. Unable to
make use of Mana, the foundation of modern society, the Norma are cast
out as outsiders and treated with much aggression and hatred. 
This mutation only occurs in women, though the reason why is unknown. 
But once it is discovered that someone is a Norma, the Quarantine
Officer casts them out into isolation on Arzenal, fated to fight
against the Dragons.

articles.desc:
A system installed in the Unicorn Gundam. When the NT-D activated, 
the Psychoframe emits a red light, the Unicorn Gundam's full body 
armor slides open, and it transforms into Destroy Mode.
A special feature of NT-D is that the Psychoframe scans for pilot 
brainwaves and incorporates them into its movements, so that thoughts 
directly influence the operation of the suit. This means that the 
tracking of the Unicorn mobile unit is significantly boosted.
When activation of NT-D has the Unicorn Gundam functioning at its 
maximum capacity, the G-force upon the pilot and the strain on the 
Psycommu are so intense that the longest it can be operated in that 
state is five minutes.
articles.desc2:
The original name behind the abbreviation NT-D is "New Type 
Destroyer," and as the phrase implies, it is a system that can detect 
and destroy enemy Newtypes. When the system identifies an enemy 
Newtype, the NT-D is activated and the Psycommu takes control of the 
pilot's awareness, transforming the machine into a pure Newtype 
killing machine.
Banagher was able to resist the Psycommu's control and managed to 
develop the ability to control the NT-D by his own willpower.

articles.desc:
Taking off some time from Jindai High, Tessa, Sousuke, and the gang
take an overnight trip to some hot springs. Tessa talks Kurz into
joining them too, talking about how one just cannot miss out on the
hot springs while in Japan, so a group of ten of them, four guys
(Sousuke, Kazama, Ono D, and Kurz) and six girls (Kaname, Tessa, 
Kyoko, Mizuki, Ren, and Mao) all head to Okutama. 
Kurz, Kazama, and Ono D try to sneak peeks at the girls' bath, but end
up getting caught up in the traps Sousuke had laid out beforehand.
Refusing to give up, they try and climb up the mountain in order to
break in, but Ono D and Kurz end up tripping each other up. Kazama is
ready to give up after this, but Kurz gives him a hearty pep talk and
they all get back at it. With their new, unfounded sense of resolve,
they finally manage to break into the bath, only to discover that
they were on timed schedules, and they have broken in to what is then
simply the men's bath—all while the girls remain completely oblivious
to the whole situation.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
Unit left behind by ancient Martians that controlled Boson Jumping. 
Towards the end of the Lizard War, the forces of Earth and Jupiter 
battled fiercely over them; however, the crew of the Nadesico made a 
jump to a far away location with both unit and the Nadesico A.
articles.desc2:
Later, the Crimson Group and the Martian Successors secretly picked 
up the unit, and, using Yurika Misumaru as a translation machine, 
they made it possible for people other than Jumpers to Boson Jump by 
controlling the image projection to the Calculation Unit, which was 
previously only possible for a Class-A Jumper.

articles.desc:
Officially the United Emirates of Orb, this is a small nation of 
numerous islands located in the Pacific Ocean. It is a rare example 
of a country where Naturals and Coordinators coexist in harmony, and 
which has sworn itself to neutrality, participating in neither the 
Federation nor ZAFT.
It is also home to the semi-nationalized company Morgenroete, Inc. 
The former leader of this company, Uzumi Nalla Athha, tasked his 
daughter Cagalli with realizing the ambitions he had for his company, 
but the five noble families who ruled the country had conflicting 
opinions about his plans, causing confusion and disagreement.
Among these families, Unato Ema Seiran, the prime minister of Orb and 
head of the Seiran family, was particularly ambitious and tried to 
maneuver so that his son, Yuna Roma Seiran, would marry Cagalli, 
thinking that this would allow him to rule the country as he pleased. 
In addition, through Logos, he abandoned the neutral principles of 
Orb to form an alliance with United Earth Federation. However, in the 
battle between Cagalli and Archangel, the tyranny of the Seiran 
family ended and Orb returned to its original stance of neutrality.

articles.series: True Mazinger Edition Z: The Impact!
articles.desc:
The world of the past where Zeus fought the Mycenaean Gods. It was 
saved within the Kedora's memories, which allowed Koji's team to 
experience it. There, Zeus betrayed Mycenae in order to protect the 
human race and lead a rebellion. He managed to defeat the Mycenaean 
Gods, but fell into a trap laid by Archduke Gorgon and Hades, one of 
the Three Great Mycenaean Gods, and lost his right arm. 
However, thanks to Koji and Mazinger Z coming to the rescue, Zeus 
managed to defeat Hades. Through this event, Koji's team learned 
about Bardos Island, the Mycenaean Gods, and about Baron Ashura's 
past.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
A character that used to be extremely popular worldwide. When the 
hype surrounding it finally died down, Jasmine bought up all the 
remaining merchandise, including some full body costumes. 
In Arzenal, only Vivian and a few others still care for this
character at all.

The name given to new space colonies where Coordinators live. It also 
became to be used to denote the nation that these colonies eventually 
formed, and from there, the nation of Coordinators. It is an 
abbreviation for "Productive Location Ally on Nexus Technology" and 
is also a reference to a large-scale manufacturing base.
As a nation, PLANT is governed by the PLANT Supreme Council. 
Previously, the Earth Alliance imposed heavy taxes in an effort to 
prevent the autonomy of PLANT, which sparked a great war. The 
inhabited PLANTs are clustered in sector L5, one of the Lagrange 
points, where gravitational pull between the Earth and the Moon is 
equal.

Catherine Vuitton's international thief gang, which is composed 
entirely of women who dress up in men's clothes and masks and call 
themselves Cat Girls. They'll do anything they have to in order to 
get their paws on what their boss Catherine wants, whether it's a 
jewel or the ingredients to a youth rejuvenation elixir.

Captain of the Jupitris and the leader of the Earth Federation's 
Jupiter Fleet. He has powerful Newtype abilities with great charisma, 
and is also a gifted mobile suit designer, a skilled pilot, and 
capable of proposing strategy and leading combat, making him an 
all-around genius.
Scirocco charmed Sarah Zabiarov, convinced Reccoa to betray AEUG, and 
even managed to make an ally of the fastidious Yazan Gable. He 
famously said that "after the war, women will rule the world," but 
the meaning of this was never fully understood.
Ostensibly, he was aligned to the Titans; however, the lofty 
ambitions that sprung from his abilities could not be satisfied in 
the context of the armed forces, and he assassinated Jamitov Hymen in 
a coup d'état, whereby he took control of the Titans. Finally, he 
took to his mobile suit, The O, for a fierce battle with Kamille.
He was overwhelmed by the power of the spirits surrounding Kamille 
and the power derived from this by the Z Gundam, but Scirocco's 
tenacity caused Kamille to have a mental breakdown.
The Gamillan name for Pluto.

A giant mobile suit developed by Neo Zeon for Newtypes, equipped not 
only with Psycommu and funnel systems, but also fitted with Mega 
Particle Cannons and Beam Sabers for close-range fighting.
The head, which acted as escape equipment, was able to separate and 
fly independently. It was piloted by Glemy's trump card, Ple Two, and 
annihilated the Gundam team.

The only daughter of Adenaur, Vice-Minister of the Earth Federation 
Forces. Her full name is Quess Paraya.
Quess has a reckless personality, wild mood swings, and takes a 
critical view of people. She is intrigued by Newtypes and underwent 
training in India.
At Londenion, she met and was enthralled by Char, which prompted her 
to go to Neo Zeon, where she awakened her abilities as a Newtype. 
Eventually, she was given a Jagd Doga and she entered the battlefield 
to help Char. During battle, she killed her father Adenaur without 
realizing who her opponent was.
Both Gyunei and Hathaway developed a love interest for her, but Quess 
is attracted to older men such as Amuro and Char, in whom she sought 
a father-figure.
In the Axis Battle, she fought using the giant mobile armor, α Azieru;
however, when she encountered Hathaway again, she was attacked
and killed by Chan Agi while defending Hathaway.

articles.series: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid
articles.desc:
The day that Kaname shared a kiss with Leonard. 
Kaname had sensed that someone was following her this day and tried
to call on Sousuke for help, not knowing that Sousuke had already
been pulled off the mission. Realizing she had no one left to depend
on, Kaname resolves to handle things herself. 
She draws her follower, Yu Lan, out and challenges her under the
rainy skies. As Yu Lan gets taken down, Leonard Testarossa reveals
himself, finishing off Yu Lan for betraying his organization. In a 
display of his feelings for her, Leonard then steals a kiss from 
Kaname.

A battle that took place in the vicinity of Mobile Space Fortress 
Messiah. It began when the United Emirates of Orb and other nations 
took action to stop Gilbert Durandal, who recklessly attempted to use 
the Requiem superweapon to destroy those who opposed the Destiny 
Plan that he advocated.
During the battle, the Orb forces destroyed Requiem. The war ended 
when Durandal was killed in the destruction of Mobile Space Fortress 
Messiah.

A method of communication only possible between Whispered. The two
connect at a deep mental level, allowing them not only to simply
communicate and share information with one another, but actually
allowing them to fuse their thoughts as one. 
Though it might seem like a useful ability, in much the same way you
cannot separate two liquids that have been mixed together, it can
be hard to separate the two thoughts, and one stands the risk of
being lost completely in the other.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
An Innovade created by Aeolia Schenberg. His full name was Ribbons 
Almark. Because he was designed not to age, his external appearance 
did not change with the passage of time. 
Previously he worked with Alejandro, and later he acted secretly 
promoting the establishment of A-Laws. He tried to control humans, 
whom he despised. However, he was in fact created for the purpose of 
helping the advancement of humanity. 
He was defeated and died in a battle with Setsuna.

articles.series: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
articles.desc:
An attack plan created and led by Jill. 
Only a select few within Arzenal ever knew about this plan.
articles.desc2:
An attack plan created and led by Jill. 
The main goal was to take down Embryo and end his control over the
world, but only a very few in Arzenal even knew about it. 
There had been a prior Libertus attempt in the past, but it ended in
failure and resulted in the deaths of many, including Tusk's parents.
This was also when Jill lost her arm. 
The survivors went back to bide their time, and once Ange appeared
and was able to pilot the Villkiss, they started to put their new
plans into motion. In the end, Ange became the center of the newly
named Last Libertus.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
The Aestivalis unit, of which Ryoko was captain. When Ryoko 
transferred to the United Forces, she became a pilot instructor, and 
this unit that she led was made up entirely of her former students.
The name "Lion's Sickle" originates from the sickle at the head of 
the constellation Leo.
At the Terminal Colony Amaterasu, the unit was attacked by Ghost 
Robots.

The first prime minister of the Earth Federation and an ancestor of 
Riddhe Marcenas.
Marcenas moved the prime minister's residence into space and lived 
there himself, ahead of general space immigration. He died in an 
explosion at the residence that took place during a ceremony to mark 
the changing of the calendar and the start of the Universal Century. 
The bombing later became known as the Laplace Incident and was a 
decisive turning point for the Universal Century and the Spacenoids.

Officially known as the False Axis Repulsive Field Generator System. 
It converts the user's thoughts directly into physical movements via
TAROS (Transfer And Response Omnisphere). It creates an invisible 
force field which it can then use for both attack and defense. This 
allows Lambda Driver-equipped AS to display far greater combat 
abilities than their normal counterparts. 
In order to use a Lambda Driver, however, the pilot must have an
ironclad willpower that is required in accessing the TAROS via special
brainwaves called gamma waves, or they must continue taking drugs
designed to grant the same effect.

A paramilitary industrial organization said to exist since the dawn 
of history, with the power to intervene decisively in politics. Those 
in charge can be called merchants of death as they work in the 
shadows to manipulate war and reconstruction in order to secure 
themselves the biggest share of the profits.
Logos is the supporting body behind Blue Cosmos and was also involved 
in forcibly swaying public opinion in order to encourage fighting 
between the Earth Alliance and the Coordinators. The former leader of 
Blue Cosmos, Muruta Azrael, and the present leader, Lord Djibril, are 
members of Logos also. The chief aim of Logos is perpetuation of war, 
as this would allow it to reap the biggest profits. Blue Cosmos' aim 
to eradicate Coordinators is mainly attributable to the personal 
resentment that the two aforementioned leaders feel towards 
Coordinators.
Logos do not possess their own fighting forces, so in the previous 
war they used Earth Alliance in an effort to annihilate the 
Coordinators. Following the war, they established Phantom Pain in the 
hope that it would give them more control.
Later, their existence and location was confirmed by Durandal, 
whereupon the majority of members were violently apprehended by
angry citizens or were lynched and killed. Djibril survived, but after 
losing his trump card, Requiem, he was seen fleeing in his ship.

Soldiers from the dispersed Titans, who fought alongside Jerid.
Lila Milla Rira belonged to the Titans' Battlecruiser Bosnia. She was 
a Galbaldy Beta pilot ranked commander. She fought against AEUG, who 
attempted to land in the Jaburo, and battled Kamille in his Gundam 
Mk-II. Soon after taking to her mobile suit, she was shot down by 
Kamille.
Kacricon Cacooler was a Titans officer ranked lieutenant. He was 
close friends with his colleague, Jerid, and often worked together 
with him. When he tried to enter the atmosphere, his ballute was cut 
up by Kamille's Gundam Mk-II, and he was burnt up.
Mouar Pharaoh was a Titans officer ranked ensign. She first met Jerid 
when she escaped from Jaburi, and stayed by his side, gradually 
falling in love with him over time. She was a capable pilot with 
strong ability to make calm decisions and take action decisively. She 
continued to support Jerid, but she died protecting him from the 
attack of the Z Gundam.
Jerid's determination to defeat Kamille was reinforced after their 
deaths.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
Refers to the time when, having lost many companions in battle 
with the United Nation Forces, Sumeragi left Celestial Being in
frustration at a feeling of her own powerlessness. 
During those two years, she spent every day drinking while she
stayed with Billy Katagiri.

The only battle that the UN Cosmo Navy won during the battle with
Gamillas. This victory allowed them to prevent the fleet from
directly attacking Earth, but it also caused Gamillas to change their
strategies to long range Planet Bombs, which forced the entire human
race to flee all major cities.

A war that began on February 27, UC 0093 and continued until March 12 
the same year. Also known as "Char's Rebellion."
Char openly declared war on the Earth Federation during a live 
interview on February 27. On March 3, he dropped the asteroid Fifth 
Luna on Lhasa, Tibet, where the Federation headquarters were located. 
On March 12, he attempted to drop Axis onto Earth, but his plan was 
thwarted by the struggle with Londo Bell, bringing the war to its 
conclusion.

The cousin of Berah Ronah. Her full name is Sherindon Ronahm, AKA 
Sherry.
Sherry was the daughter of a distinguished family and, after the 
collapse of Cosmo Babylonia, she was exalted by people who hoped to 
restore aristocratism. She is a Newtype who strived to surround 
herself with other talented Newtypes. After meeting Tobia, Sherry 
also recognized how talented Tobia was and tried to make him stay by 
her side. She is fundamentally an aristocratist with an elitist 
attitude; she lost hope in the old human race and longs for an era of 
new humans, or Newtypes, adapted to space.

The dimension in which Earth constructed the Yamato. 
Attacks by Gamillas have left the oceans completely dry. 
Major historical incidents are as follows: 
-Before 0199: The Earth Federation is founded. 
　　　　　　　　　This is considered to be New Correct Century year
　　　　　　　　　2000.
-Approximately before 0100: One Year War - Second Neo Zeon Conflict
　　　　　　　　　(AKA Char's Rebellion)
　　　　　　　　　The ten years between the end of the Second Neo Zeon
　　　　　　　　　Conflict and the Mufti Incident are known as the
　　　　　　　　　"Lost Decade," and little information remains about
　　　　　　　　　what went on during these years.
-Before 0012: Cosmo Babylonia Wars 
-Before 0008: Contact with intelligent extraterrestrial life from Gamillas
-Before 0005: First Battle in the Vicinity of Mars 
　　　　　　　　　The Earth Federation Forces wins the battle, but
　　　　　　　　　Gamillas establishes their Pluto Frontline Base and
　　　　　　　　　begins to attack with Planet Bombs.
-Before 0002: Jupiter War 
　　　　　　　　　During the disorder, the Planet Bomb attacks really
　　　　　　　　　kick off, pushing the Earth to near-devastation.
-Before 0001: A messenger from Iscandar descends to Earth.
articles.desc2:
The dimension in which Earth constructed the Yamato.
It is later revealed that the Earth in this dimension has actually been
visited by Gamillans and Nevanlinna from the great Magellan galaxy,
and that the world itself was split from the Universal Century dimension
by a distortion in space-time that resulted from the war between Embryo
and the Mycenae Gods. 
Major historical incidents are as follows: 
-Approximately before 3000: Gamillans and Nevanlinna visit Earth from
the Large Magellanic Cloud.
　　　　　　　　　All civilization on Earth is destroyed in the battle
　　　　　　　　　between Embryo and Mycenae, and a completely new
　　　　　　　　　civilization rises up and continues to the present day.
-Before 0199: The Earth Federation is founded. 
　　　　　　　　　This is considered to be New Correct Century year
　　　　　　　　　2000.

　　　　　　　　　The ten years between the end of the Second Neo Zeon

　　　　　　　　　Decade," and little information remains about what
　　　　　　　　　went on during these years.

　　　　　　　　　The Earth Federation Forces wins the battle, but

　　　　　　　　　begins to attack with Planet Bombs.
