　　　　　　　　　During the disorder, the Planet Bomb attacks really
　　　　　　　　　kick off, pushing the Earth to near-devastation.
-Before 0001: A messenger from Iscandar descends to Earth.

articles.desc:
Refers to Stella Loussier, a pilot attached to Earth Alliance 81st 
Independent Mobile Battalion, "Phantom Pain." Deceased.
Because she had been physically enhanced, she had abilities beyond 
those of normal people. Her memories were also altered in order to 
make her a more effective pilot, but this also caused her to become 
emotionally unstable in battle.
She and ZAFT pilot Shinn Asuka developed a mutual affection for one 
another. However, the memory manipulation she underwent caused her to 
forget Shinn. Stella wreaked havoc in Berlin when she attacked Shinn 
in the Impulse Gundam, as he was trying to stop her. Shinn refused to 
give up hope and succeeded in convincing her to give up fighting 
briefly. However, this didn't last long and the fear she felt at the 
sight of the Freedom Gundam piloted by Kira Yamato caused her to lose 
her mind. She went on a rampage and nearly shot down Impulse, which
was nearby. Finally, in order to protect Shinn, Kira attacked Destroy 
Gundam, which Stella was piloting, fatally wounding Stella. She died in
Shinn's arms, and as a result of this incident, Shinn became angry and
resentful of Kira, swearing to take his revenge.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
The older brother of Yukina Shiratori, now deceased. His full name 
was Tsukumo Shiratori, and he was a major of the Jovian Federation 
and the pilot of Tetsujin and Daitetsujin. 
During the Lizard War, he fell in love with Minato and got to know 
the people of Earth. This motivated him to work for peace, but he 
fell for the plot of the former Jovian Federation supreme commander, 
Haruki Kusakabe, and was shot dead by his close friend Genichiro 
Tsukiomi. 
His death was used to fuel the fighting determination of the Jovian 
Federation.

A system that allows one to learn different things while asleep. Half 
a year before Gaizok came to attack the Earth, Kappei started sleep 
learning under Heizaemon's supervision and learned a great deal about 
Zambot 3. Another effect of sleep learning is that it erased any 
sense of fear from Kappei and his comrades, which is what allowed 
them to fight against Gaizok.

A young girl whose psyche was left behind in the underground TAROS
facility in the hidden city of Yamsk 11. She was the subject of an 
experiment 18 years ago and the original source of the Whispered.
articles.desc2:
Taking control of Kaname's mind, she worked along with Leonard to try
to recreate the world. But as they attempted to use the completed
TARTAROS, Sousuke's abuse awakens the real Kaname, and their plans
are put to an end.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
A private military organization that possesses Gundam. It was first 
founded by engineer and biologist Aeolia Schenberg from the 21st to 
22nd century.
It proclaimed its aim to be the elimination of wars and conducted 
military interventions in all areas of conflict. 
The organization comprised Gundam Meisters, who piloted Gundams, 
together with the crew and support teams of their carriers. They also 
possessed the quantum supercomputer Veda. 
Although Celestial Being was destroyed by the forces of the three 
world powers, because the world united in the effort to oppose the 
existence of Celestial Being, it in a sense achieved its aim.  
However, a new-born Earth Federation was under the control of 
Innovades, and Celestial Being again started its operations to 
counter distortions in world power.

The dimension which Yamato was thrown to from the AD dimension. 
The seas in this world are a deep red due to the effects of the
Second Impact. 
Major historical incidents are as follows: 
-0100 years ago: The Earth Federation is founded. 
　　　　　　　　　During the founding commemoration ceremony, the
　　　　　　　　　Laplace Incident occurs. 
-0017 years ago: Invader Assault 
　　　　　　　　　Humankind wins the Lunar Conflict and drives out the
　　　　　　　　　Invaders. 
-0015 years ago: One Year War 
　　　　　　　　　At the end of the war, the Getter Ray Escape Incident
　　　　　　　　　and the Second Impact both occur at nearly the same
　　　　　　　　　time, dealing a devastating blow to the Earth
　　　　　　　　　Federation.
　　　　　　　　　Afterwards, skirmishes continue between the Earth 
　　　　　　　　　Federation and Zeon during their standstill to conserve 
　　　　　　　　　their strength.
-0002 years ago: In order to reinstate the Earth Federation, the Titans
　　　　　　　　　took hardline tactics and faced off against AEUG, an
　　　　　　　　　anti-federation group that felt threatened by this,
　　　　　　　　　kicking off the Gryps Conflict.
-0001 year ago: War breaks out between Haman's Neo Zeon and the Earth
　　　　　　　　　Federation at the end of the Gryps Conflict (First
　　　　　　　　　Neo Zeon Conflict).
　　　　　　　　　After Haman is taken down in battle, Char takes lead
　　　　　　　　　of Neo Zeon and continues the battle Haman started
　　　　　　　　　(Second Neo Zeon Conflict).
　　　　　　　　　After Char's whereabouts are lost, all surface
　　　　　　　　　happenings of the Neo Zeon conflict come to a halt.
　　　　　　　　　Dr. Hell's invasion begins.
articles.desc2:
The dimension which Yamato was thrown to from the AD dimension. 
The seas in this world are a deep red due to the effects of the
Second Impact. It is later revealed that this world was split from
the New Correct Century dimension by the war between Embryo and the 
Mycenae Gods.
Major historical incidents are as follows: 
-3000 years ago: All civilization on Earth is wiped out by the battle
　　　　　　　　　between Mycenae and Embryo.
　　　　　　　　　Embryo travels to the AD dimension.
　　　　　　　　　The Dragon clan starts up their own civilization
　　　　　　　　　within a barrier.
　　　　　　　　　Outside of the barrier, a completely separate
　　　　　　　　　civilization is formed which continues on until the
　　　　　　　　　present day.
　　　　　　　　　In order to create the AD dimension after his own
　　　　　　　　　personal ideal world, Embryo kidnaps Aura.
-0100 years ago: The Earth Federation is founded.
　　　　　　　　　During the founding commemoration ceremony, the

　　　　　　　　　After Haman is taken down in battle, Char takes lead
　　　　　　　　　of Neo Zeon and continues the battle Haman started

　　　　　　　　　After Char's whereabouts are lost, all surface
　　　　　　　　　happenings of the Neo Zeon conflict come to a halt.
　　　　　　　　　Dr. Hell's invasion begins.

articles.desc:
A group of space pirates who fight against Jupiter Empire, led by 
Berah Ronah.
A terror attack on board the new vessel, Babylona Vanguard, that 
occurred during its maiden voyage, Berah and Kincade found out about 
the existence of the Jupiter Empire, who were planning to invade 
Earth. They established the group in response.
The origin of the group's name is Crossbone Vanguard, an organization 
which previously promoted aristocratism; this name was purposefully 
chosen as a ploy to attract people and resources. Berah herself had 
denounced aristocratism, which contributed to support for the idea 
dwindling.
Consequently, this name meant that members of the group were split 
into two halves: one side were anti-aristocratists and followers of 
Berah, while the other were hoping for the restoration of 
aristocratism.
They group fought against the Jupiter Empire, which planned to invade 
Earth, but they were considered an antisocial space pirate 
organization because of their guerrilla tactics and attacks on 
disguised Jovian vessels. In the beginning, they played the role of 
the lone vigilante because the Federation was not yet aware of 
Jupiter Empire's ambitions. However, after Jupiter Empire's Supreme 
Leader Dogatie declared that he intended to carry out a nuclear 
attack on the Earth, the Federation Forces collaborated with the 
Crossbone Vanguard to defeat Jupiter Empire.
Following the Jupiter War, Kincade and Berah left the group, but 
Tobia took over the reigns and they continued to fight secretly 
against remnants of Jupiter Empire.

articles.desc:
The common name for the Second Neo Zeon War, which began on February 
27, UC 0093 and continued until March 12 the same year. During this 
war, Char attempted to drop the asteroid Axis onto Earth.

Refers to the body double of Mineva Zabi, the last surviving member 
of the Zabi family of the Principality of Zeon. 
It was later revealed that the Mineva Zabi who appeared in public 
during the Gryps Conflict and the First Neo Zeon War was a body 
double.

The Civilization Reconstruction System developed by the Super
Civilization Gardim. ERS-100, AKA Nine, is a part of this system.

articles.series: True Mazinger Edition Z: The Impact!
articles.desc:
An authority on robot engineering who can go toe to toe with Juzo and 
Kenzo Kabuto. His full name is Schtroheim Heinrich. He created the 
Gamia Qs and Danube α1. He used to be engaged to Tsubasa, but after 
Tsubasa and Kenzo returned from Bardos Island, they had given birth 
to two children. Then, since Tsubasa wanted the strongest robot 
possible in order to fight Dr. Hell, she ended up killing Dr. Schtroheim.
After this, he was revived by Dr. Hell under the condition that he should 
create the strongest robot in existence. 
He then created the Danube α1, which is autonomous, and also created 
Lorelei, who became his beloved daughter and the brain of the Danube 
α1. Schtroheim suffered fatal injuries when trying to steal back the 
Danube α1 from Baron Ashura, and left his dreams of defeating 
Mazinger Z to Lorelei before he perished.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
Facilities that were constructed in space in order to realize the 
Hisago Plan. They were constructed based on the plan to build a 
network for Boson Jumping within the Solar System, which needed entry 
and exit points for jumping. 
Amaterasu was one of the Terminal Colonies and, as with other 
colonies, was under the control of the Colonial Development 
Corporation and the United Forces.
articles.desc2:
Facilities that were constructed in space in order to realize the 
Hisago Plan. They were constructed based on the plan to build a 
network for Boson Jumping within the Solar System, which needed entry 
and exit points for jumping. 
Amaterasu was one of the Terminal Colonies and, as with other 
colonies, should have been under the control of the Colonial 
Development Corporation and the United Forces, but in fact internally 
it was already under the control of the Martian Successors.

articles.desc:
This dimension, which Yamato was thrown to from out of a dimensional
rift, is currently enjoying a time of peace, though it faced large scale wars
only years ago.
The main incidents during that time were as follows:
-0003 years ago: War breaks out between nations of Earth and PLANT

The battle that commenced when Shin Dragon first awakened.
Dr. Saotome, who was thought to be dead, returned to the abandoned 
Saotome Laboratory along with the Getter G Army, forcing Ryoma 
Nagare, Hayato Jin, and Musashi Tomoe to gather up amid much 
confusion. In the end, Ryoma Nagare was swallowed up into the light 
that was produced when he went in to stop the Deuteron missile that 
the UN fired, while Musashi Tomoe was killed by a swarm of revived 
Invaders. This battle polluted the world with Getter Rays, severely 
damaging it.

articles.term: That Time During the Gryps Conflict
articles.desc:
Refers to the battle between Paptimus Scirocco and Kamille Bidan that 
occurred towards the end of the Gryps Conflict. Because the Titans' 
fleet sustained heavy damage from the Colony Laser, Scirocco made the 
call to retreat and regroup the fleet, but he was pursued by Kamille.
A fierce battle then took place between Scirocco's mobile suit, The 
O, and Kamille's Zeta Gundam. Kamille drew on the strength of his 
friends who had passed away to power his Z Gundam and defeat 
Scirocco. 
However, as he was dying, Scirocco managed to unleash his thoughts 
onto Kamille, causing him to have a mental breakdown.

Former PLANT Supreme Council Chairman. Unlike the previous Chairman, 
Patrick Zala, Durandal belonged to a moderate faction which sought 
peaceful coexistence with Naturals. At the time of the Junius Seven 
incident and during the later battle with the Earth Alliance, he 
displayed outstanding leadership, always making level-headed 
decisions.
Meer Campbell was suggested as a double for Lacus Clyne to bolster 
the fighting spirit of the PLANTs as a whole, but the secret plan to 
assassinate Lacus was leaked to the public, causing distrust among 
Kira and his associates.
Durandal's ultimate aim was to realize his "Destiny Plan," in which 
he would construct a regulated society where people were controlled 
at a genetic level. After defeating Logos, he introduced his plan to 
the world, pushing for its implementation. However, Kira and his 
colleagues opposed the idea of a world in which there would be no 
evolution and successfully prevented the plan from being carried out.
Eventually, Durandal was shot by Rey Za Burrel, who he had thought of 
as his own son. He took his last breaths in the arms of his former 
lover, Talia Gladys, who, although they had separated, still had 
feelings for him.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
The nickname of the Celestial Being carrier Ptolemaios. The name was 
used for both the original Ptolemaios and its successor Ptolemaios 2.

Her full name is Ume Jin. She acts as an advisor for the Jin family 
and has earned the full trust of Heizaemon. She likes rock music and 
donned a fighting uniform and went out to fight in order to save her 
first love, Nozaki. Even though she's up in her years, she rarely 
lets people notice that.
When she went into outer space for the final battle, she and 
Heizaemon launched an assault on Bandock with Beal II in order to 
save King Beal. They left the future to their grandchildren and 
perished there. Before she went out, she passed down the teacup that 
Heizaemon had sent to her when he was young.

articles.series: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid
articles.desc:
Used to describe Clouseau's hobby of watching anime. Clouseau is an
absolute anime nut, always reading the latest magazines to stay
up-to-date with all his favorite series. But while he says he's not
embarrassed about this, he still tries to hide it from his crew to
"preserve moral." Kurz, however, ends up finding out anyway after 
going through some personal belongings.

An executive at Anaheim Electronics whose full name was Wong Lee. He 
monitored the AEUG on Argama with full authority from Melanie Hue 
Carbine, chairman of the company.

articles.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 the Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
articles.desc:
The quantum supercomputer system designed as the core for 
implementing the plans of Aeolia Schenberg. It possessed information 
processing capacity incomprehensibly greater than a regular computer, 
making it an important force in Celestial Being's struggle against 
the world. 
However, Alejandro Corner gained control of Veda with the help of 
Ribbons Almark, who took over the reins after Alejandro's death. 
The computer itself is located on-board the space cruiser Celestial 
Being.

The codename used by Mithril to refer to Lambda Driver-equipped enemy
Chodar AS units.

Humans with special knowledge of future technology that has yet to
be developed. This unknown technology is called Black Technology and
holds the power to greatly upset the world's current state of balance
among military powers. It is for this very reason that numerous
organizations have devised plans to capture and use the Whispered.
Mithril, meanwhile, works to rescue and defend the Whispered from 
such groups. 
The reasons and manners behind it are not yet understood, but this
knowledge of Black Technology seems to come from someone or 
something almost talking directly to deep reaches of the Whispered's
brains. 
The Lambda Drivers themselves are one piece of such Black Technology. 
Kaname Chidori and Teletha Testarossa are two recognized Whispered,
but Amalgam is said to have Whispered on their side as well.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
An Aestivalis pilot aboard Nadesico A during the Lizard War. His full 
name was Jiro Yamada but he preferred his spirit name, Gai Daigohji, 
and would correct anyone who tried to call him by his real name.
He liked the anime Gekiganger 3 and was so hooked on it that he would 
shout out the names of techniques when he was operating the 
Aestivalis. His love for the show was the reason why Akito became 
such a fan of the anime. 
Munetake, Earth Federation Space Force Admiral, happened to see him 
escape from Nadesico, and one of his subordinates shot and killed 
him. Although they only knew each other for a short time, his death 
had a deep impact on Akito.

The world's first TAROS (Transfer And Response Omnisphere) experiment
18 years ago.
The experiment failed when TAROS went out of control, killing the subject
named Sophia, while emitting Iota waves and Tau waves (2 psychic waves)
from the epicenter of the explosion.
Although the Iota waves only covered a 30 kilometer radius of the
epicenter, Yamsk was completely inundated with psychic waves.
As for the Tau waves, which blanketed the entire world, they have hardly
any ill effects on most people.
However, the waves covered the world for three minutes, and changed
the newborns. Their brains were all affected, and those children, are all
Whispered.
The fact that Kaname is one of the Whispered.

articles.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture – Prince of Darkness
articles.desc:
A top-secret battleship built by Nergal Heavy Industries. It used the 
perfected one-operator system tested in Nadesico B, making it a 
prototype for Nadesico C. 
It was the carrier for Akito's Black Selena and was fitted with 
quadruple Gravity Blast as standard equipment. It also carried many 
Batta, the unmanned weapons used by Jovian Federation. 
Incidentally, Eucharis is the name of a bulbous plant in the 
Amaryllis family, and its name signifies "pure heart."

Her real name was Yumi. She passed away
along with her mother and father during a Planet Bomb attack.

Yazan Gable, originally a member of the Titans. Judau Ashta and his 
gang discovered him in an escape pod. When he realized that Argama 
was in Shangri-La, he persuaded them to steal the Zeta Gundam.
Eventually, Judau turned on Yazan when he found out about the methods 
he used, but his attack was unsuccessful. Later, he teamed with junk 
dealer Gemon Bajack and again attacked Argama, but Judau escaped and 
was never heard of again.

An abbreviation of the phrase, "Zodiac Alliance of Freedom Treaty," 
denoting PLANT's military.
Originating from a political alliance created by Siegel Clyne and 
Patrick Zala, ZAFT is a military organization composed of volunteer 
Coordinators. All members undergo the same battle training with no 
distinction between land, air or sea forces. Elite soldiers are 
distinguishable by their red uniforms.
There are no ranks like in a regular army; instead, forces are 
organized into teams named after their commanders. Supreme authority 
rests with the National Defense Committee Chairman.

The race that immigrated from the planet of Zaltz after it merged with
the Great Gamillan Empire. They are very serious and extremely loyal
to Gamillas, but since they have the same skin color as Earthlings,
they are called an "inferior race" by Gamillans, who take pride in
their blue skin. The fleet led by Shultz on the Gamillas Pluto
Frontline Base is made up of Zaltzians.

articles.series: True Mazinger Edition Z: The Impact!
articles.desc:
One of the Three Great Mycenaean Gods, and the ruler of them all. A 
long time ago, he led a rebellion to protect the human race from the 
Mycenaean Gods. When he fights, his armor shines with a golden sheen, 
and he wields a weapon that can change into a sword or spear. There 
is a Z etched in both his sword and his forehead. Koji, Tsubasa, and 
Baron Ashura met him when they were thrown into Ancient Mycenae 
through the Kedora's memories.
Hades managed to surprise him with a trap and cut off his right arm, 
but Zeus managed to defeat Hades after teaming up with Mazinger Z. 
His right arm became Japanium Ore, which was left underneath Bardos 
Island, and later became the source of photonic power energy and 
Super Alloy Z.
The Gamillan name for Jupiter.
